source.name: LavoLoop services marketplace
source.caveat: Marketplace-reported usage and payer counts are external-demand evidence only. They are not James live quotes, paid outcomes, provider latency, deterministic acceptance results, or effective cost per acceptable result. Raw transaction volume can be distorted; payer diversity is the stronger signal and still requires caution.

observations.endpointDescription: Exa Search - Neural search across the web
Exa semantic web search via provider API key

decisionImpact: External demand for machine-paid structured web search remains observable across multiple providers and payer populations. This reduces category-demand risk but does not resolve James's core proof gate: whether deterministic task-specific outcome economics changes provider selection versus price, health, reputation or popularity routing.
